product_family: Bolt (bolt.new) - AI full-stack web app builder. Built and operated by StackBlitz; legal/privacy entity is StackBlitz, Inc.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1
certifications.proof_quote: Listed under Certifications on the trust center: 'SOC 2 Type 1, GDPR, CCPA.' Supporting context: 'Our security program is built on industry-standard practices, including enterprise-grade encryption, continuous monitoring, and browser-level isolation to safeguard customer intellectual property.' Note: SOC 2 Type 1 is a point-in-time design attestation, weaker than a Type II operating-effectiveness report.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: February 25, 2026: SOC 2 Type II report availability. SOC 2 Type II audit report will be available at the end of the 2nd quarter of 2026.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Listed under Certifications on the trust center: 'SOC 2 Type 1, GDPR, CCPA.' Vendor self-attests GDPR compliance; this is a regulatory/compliance framework, not a third-party audit certification.

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: Listed under Certifications on the trust center: 'SOC 2 Type 1, GDPR, CCPA.' Vendor self-attests CCPA compliance; this is a regulatory/compliance framework, not a third-party audit certification.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Not listed among certifications on the trust center; only SOC 2 Type 1, GDPR, and CCPA are shown.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Not listed on the trust center; bolt.new does not advertise HIPAA compliance or sign BAAs. Do not use for PHI without contractual confirmation.

privacy.ai_training_note: Trains/improves models on customer AI inputs and outputs BY DEFAULT, but only on aggregated, anonymized, or de-identified data, with a plan-dependent opt-out. Verbatim: 'We may use AI Inputs and AI Outputs to operate, maintain, and improve the Services, including improving AI performance, reliability, and safety. Such use shall be on aggregated, anonymized, or de-identified data.' Opt-out: 'Depending on account type or plan, users may have the ability to limit or opt out of the use of AI Inputs and AI Outputs for model training or improvement.' Third-party LLM providers (Anthropic Claude and others) 'process AI Inputs solely to provide services to Bolt and are subject to contractual confidentiality and data protection obligations.'
privacy.data_region: United States (data may be transferred to / processed / stored outside user's jurisdiction). Verbatim: 'Bolt is headquartered in the United States, and personal information may be transferred to, processed, and stored in countries outside of your jurisdiction, including the United States.'

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Yes (control listed: 'Encryption-at-rest' under Data Security; 'enterprise-grade encryption' referenced)

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Implied via 'enterprise-grade encryption' and HTTPS; not separately itemized on trust center

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: unknown - not explicitly stated; a 'Vulnerability Management Policy' document is listed but no pen-test attestation is published

security.name: Bug bounty / vulnerability disclosure
security.value: No public bug bounty platform (HackerOne/Bugcrowd) found for bolt.new. Bugcrowd results for 'Bolt' belong to the unrelated ride-hailing company bolt.eu, not StackBlitz/bolt.new.

security.name: Architecture / isolation
security.value: Client-side code execution; 'It executes code entirely client-side, ensuring a zero-trust environment that minimizes server-side attack surfaces' plus browser-level isolation

security.name: Endpoint security
security.value: Disk Encryption, MDM Solution, Endpoint Detection and Response (controls listed)

security.name: BC/DR
security.value: Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery program with RTO/RPO; Disaster Recovery Plan and Business Continuity Plan documents available on request

security.name: Subprocessors disclosed
security.value: Yes - cloud/data hosting, CDN, code repository, and two code-generation LLM service providers listed on trust center

security.name: Policy documents (request access)
security.value: Information Security, Encryption, Data Protection, Vulnerability Management, Incident Response, Access Control, SDLC, Bolt AI Policy and others available on request

products.name: Bolt (bolt.new) - Standard / Free
products.data_scope: User prompts (AI Inputs) and generated code (AI Outputs) processed by StackBlitz and third-party LLM providers. May be used to improve models on anonymized/aggregated basis by default; opt-out may be limited on lower tiers.
products.notes: Best for prototypes and non-sensitive projects. No HIPAA; treat as US-hosted, may-train-by-default.

products.name: Bolt Pro / Teams
products.data_scope: Same data flow as Standard; access to Max (higher-intelligence) agent. Plan-dependent ability to limit/opt out of training.
products.notes: Adds team collaboration; verify training opt-out status in account settings.

products.name: Bolt Enterprise
products.data_scope: Marketed as the tier for organizations needing contractual data protection and compliance support; DPA available where applicable. Enterprise contracts can add data-use clauses and training opt-outs. Specific feature claims (SSO, audit logs) are typical of enterprise tiers; verify in contract.
products.notes: Path for organizations needing contractual data protection and a DPA. Confirm SSO/audit-log availability with sales.

products.name: Bolt Cloud
products.data_scope: Hosts deployed apps including their databases, user management and auth. Data processed within customer-built apps is governed by customer agreements/DPA, not StackBlitz's own privacy policy.
products.notes: Production data in deployed apps falls under a separate DPA scope.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium with paid Pro/Teams subscriptions and an Enterprise tier; token/usage-based agent access (Standard vs Max models)

flags: Trains/improves AI models on customer inputs and outputs BY DEFAULT (anonymized/aggregated), with opt-out only 'depending on account type or plan' - material for sensitive code/IP.

Several unrelated companies also use the name 'Bolt', including the ride-hailing company Bolt (bolt.eu) and market-research firm Bolt Insight; their certifications (ISO 27001/27701, a bug bounty program, and SOC 2 Type II) do not belong to bolt.new/StackBlitz. No public bug bounty program and no ISO 27001 or SOC 2 Type II are confirmed for bolt.new itself.
SOC 2 is only Type 1 today; Type II not expected until end of Q2 2026 (effectively now-ish, but report not yet published as held).
No ISO 27001 and not HIPAA-compliant - unsuitable for PHI/regulated data without contractual confirmation.
Penetration testing not explicitly attested on the trust center.
Privacy/legal entity is StackBlitz, Inc. (parent), policy hosted on stackblitz.com, not bolt.new domain.
